  PROBLEM: In test_review_blocked_fix_target_rejects_head_move_during_judge, the fixture `pr_api_sequence={901: [dict(open_pr) for _ in range(6)] + [{**open_pr, **changed_pr}]}` still expects six live reads, but the new `_fetch_pr_json` cache now serves one of them (cache_hits_pr_json=1). The invalidated live re-check (`_rb_recheck_json`) therefore gets an unchanged open_pr payload instead of the changed head.
  WHY: The poller pushes the fix commit instead of logging `reason=head_moved`, so CI shards tests-system-python (14) and orchestrate-poll (3) fail with "missing 'issue=10 pr=901 reason=head_moved'". The production guard still works because the re-check is always live. Suggested fix: change range(6) to range(5). All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:12740-12756 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In test_review_blocked_merged_fix_target_rejects_unrelated_followup, the fixture `pr_api_sequence={901: [dict(open_pr) for _ in range(4)] + [dict(merged_pr)]}` still expects four live reads before merged_pr, but one is now a cache hit. The invalidated post-judge re-fetch (`_rb_pr_json_refetched`) therefore gets an open payload instead of merged_pr.
  WHY: The merged follow-up path never runs, so the `reason=cross_repository` rejection is never logged and tests-system-python (15) fails. minimax notes that the parametrized not_implementation_pr case shares the sequence and also breaks. Suggested fix: change range(4) to range(3). All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:12832 | severity=critical | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_review_blocked_rejects_fork_head_on_merged_followup uses the same four-open-then-merged `pr_api_sequence`. The cache hit before the judge pushes merged_pr past the live re-fetch after the judge, so the expected cross_repository rejection after the merge is never reached.
  WHY: sonnet says this is very likely the orchestrate-poll (1) shard failure on head eeb6aaba, with the same fix (range(4) to range(3)), and rated it BLOCKER at confidence 3. glm lists 12832 as a same-sequence case inside its 12743-12756 BLOCKER finding.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:orchestrate-poll (1) shard failure for head eeb6aaba | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrate-poll (1) shard also failed on head eeb6aaba (run 45021586081, job 137205486544). The failing test name is cut off in the log tail, and the most likely cause is another `pr_api_sequence` length that no longer matches the new live-read count.
  WHY: The lint aggregator reports "CI jobs that did not succeed: orchestrate-poll, tests-system-python", and the gate stays red until that fixture is found and fixed. Both reviewers rated this MAJOR; sonnet attributes the shard to the 12832 test instead.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:20978-20992 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: test_close_merged_issues_sweep_default_branch_unavailable_closes_nothing still asserts `"--jq '.default_branch'" in body`. close_merged_issues_sweep now uses `_sweep_default_branch="$(_orch_poll_default_branch_or_live "" quiet)"` at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6286, so that string is gone.
  WHY: The stale source assertion fails in tests-system-python (20), although the fail-closed behaviour (`reason=default_branch_unavailable`) is unchanged. Suggested fix: assert `'_orch_poll_default_branch_or_live "" quiet' in body` instead. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.

  WHY: This is very likely the orchestrate-poll (1) shard failure on head eeb6aaba (name cut off in the log). Fix: change range(4) to range(3), and confirm the test name from the full shard log.

  WHY: tests-system-python (20) fails. Fail-closed behaviour is unchanged. Fix: assert '_orch_poll_default_branch_or_live "" quiet' in body, and keep the "|| echo main" negative assertion and the skip-ordering assertions.
